statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail) and r = true if and only if 2 * cnt > len(nums), where cnt is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that nums[i] = target.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order (for all i, j with 0 <= i <= j < len(nums), nums[i] <= nums[j]); for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= target <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = true, then nums[len(nums)/2] = target, where len(nums)/2 denotes integer division (floor).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= target <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = true, then there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) such that nums[i] = target.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= target <= 10^9.

statement: For any two inputs (nums1, target) and (nums2, target) satisfying the preconditions, if len(nums1) = len(nums2) and the number of occurrences of target in nums1 equals the number of occurrences of target in nums2, then whenever the function returns results r1 for the first input and r2 for the second, r1 = r2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= target <= 10^9.

statement: For any two inputs (nums1, target) and (nums2, target) satisfying the preconditions with len(nums1) = len(nums2), if the number of occurrences of target in nums1 is less than or equal to the number of occurrences of target in nums2, then whenever the function returns r1 for the first and r2 for the second, r1 = true implies r2 = true.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= target <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if target occurs in nums, let f be the smallest index with 0 <= f < len(nums) and nums[f] = target, and let l be the largest index with 0 <= l < len(nums) and nums[l] = target. Then r = true if and only if 2 * (l - f + 1) > len(nums). If target does not occur in nums, then r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= target <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = true, then for every value v with v != target, the number of occurrences of v in nums is strictly less than the number of occurrences of target in nums.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= target <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = true, then if f is the smallest index with 0 <= f < len(nums) and nums[f] = target, and l is the largest index with 0 <= l < len(nums) and nums[l] = target, we have f <= len(nums)/2 <= l, where len(nums)/2 denotes integer division (floor).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= target <= 10^9.

statement: For any nums satisfying the preconditions, and any two distinct values target1 and target2 in [1, 10^9], whenever the function returns r1 for (nums, target1) and r2 for (nums, target2), if r1 = true then r2 = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= target1, target2 <= 10^9; target1 != target2.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if r = true, then the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] < target is strictly less than len(nums)/2, and the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] > target is strictly less than len(nums)/2. Equivalently, twice each of these counts is strictly less than len(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 1000; nums is sorted in non-decreasing order; for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= target <= 10^9.
